summary.text: Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths takes place on Ikoria, in the walled city of Drannith and the wilds around it, where the Ozolith crystal formation appears outside the city and starts a new era of wild mutation among the monsters.

The story follows Lukka, who bonds with a winged cat and is banned from Drannith, and the planeswalker Vivien Reid, who befriends him and traces the changes to the Ozolith, along with Jirina Kudro and the bonders Brin and Barrow.

At the Ozolith Lukka gains power over the monsters and, vengeful after Drannith refuses his help, marches an army on the city; Jirina and the bonders turn the tide in the Siege of Drannith, until the Ozolith explodes and ignites Lukka's planeswalker spark.
